overloads.semanticRole: Compacts the data file (and its index file, if any) associated with a structure file, replacing the original data file in place and returning the pathname of the folder holding the preserved originals.

constraints: Can only be executed from 4D in local (single-user) mode or from 4D Server as a stored procedure.
The dataPath file must not already be open when the command is executed, otherwise an error is generated.

The option parameter is a combination of bit-flag constants from the 'Data File Maintenance' theme (e.g. Compact address table, Create process, Do not create log file, Timestamp log file name, Update records); passing 'Compact address table' alone implicitly also enables 'Update records'.
The method callback parameter is only ever invoked when the 'Create process' option bit is passed (asynchronous compacting); otherwise it is ignored.
